strings.name: dev_go_to_rain_sensor
strings.value: Go to enable the Rain sensor

strings.name: dev_text_connect_rain_sensor_disclaimer
strings.value:
DISCLAIMER
HiOazo is not affiliated with or authorized by other rain sensor providers. This article is for instructional and compatibility purposes only.

HiOazo does not recommend 3rd-party sensors unless required by local code. Always enable weather intelligence to skip watering BEFORE rain; rain sensors only act AFTER rain.

strings.name: dev_text_connect_rain_sensor_tip1
strings.value: Rain sensor wires are usually labeled \"S\", wire it into the \"S\" and \"24-\"terminals if you are running a rain sensor.

strings.name: dev_text_connect_rain_sensor_tip2
strings.value: Please enable the rain sensor on the app if if you are running a rain sensor.

strings.name: dev_text_rain_delay_reminder
strings.value: Rain delay is applied to rain sensor skip, and rain skip in the Weather Intelligence.

strings.name: dev_text_rain_sensor_reminder
strings.value: Before activating the rain sensor, please connect it correctly.

strings.name: dev_text_rain_sensor_skip_toast
strings.value: Due to the rain sensor skip, in zones relevant to device %s, watering for the next %d hours starting on %s will be skipped.

strings.name: dev_text_rain_skip_grey
strings.value: Rain skip(in grey) is not available? Enable the rain skip,or enable the rain sensor if you have an external rain sensor wired.

strings.name: dev_text_seasonal_adjust_toast
strings.value: Due to seasonal adjustment, the watering time for this zone has been changed from %s to %s.

strings.name: iic800_rain_sensor_switch_tips
strings.value: The main switch of rain sensor has been turned off.
